behavior.validation: Accept exactly the required schema keys in plain passive JSON-compatible objects and dense ordinary arrays, with finite binary64 values and safe integer descriptors; no coercion, defaults, accessors, booleans-as-numbers or retained aliases. Complete static shape/value validation precedes work preflight. Geometric/topology tests run after preflight. Failure throws Error with stable code, no partial result. Outputs are detached. Canonicalize exposed signed zero to +0. Array lengths must fit 4294967295; unsafe requested growth/work arithmetic gives WORK_LIMIT before allocation. Host resource exhaustion is a host error, not an allocation guarantee. All grid/kernel/element dimensions are positive integers; each corresponding array length/product must fit 4294967295 and match exactly, otherwise INVALID_INPUT before work.
behavior.environment: No RNG, noise, time, rendering, assets, host state, mutation or retained aliases. Data uses caller coordinate/color conventions as specified.
behavior.numerics: Separate IEEE754 binary64 arithmetic, Math.hypot and host sin/cos/sqrt for the named formulas. Check computed numeric intermediates for finiteness and throw NUMERIC_OVERFLOW on nonfinite results. No epsilon in classification or topology, no adaptive exact predicates or near-degeneracy guarantee. General scalar/coordinate comparisons allow absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12; topology, indices, order, booleans and RNG states compare exactly. Analytical shared fixtures use exact JSON output.
behavior.algorithm:
Input {stops,count,maxWork}, >=2 encoded sRGB triples in [0,1], count>=2. Output {colors}, encoded
sRGB triples. Decode each component c by c/12.92 if c<=.04045, otherwise ((c+.055)/1.055)^2.4. At
u=k/(count-1), select span min(floor(u*(N-1)),N-2), t=u*(N-1)-span, convert stops to Oklab, lerp L,a,b,
inverse convert, clamp each reconstructed linear RGB component independently to [0,1], then encode linear
c by 12.92c if c<=.0031308, otherwise 1.055*c^(1/2.4)-.055. Output k=0 and k=count-1 are copied exact
input endpoint triples. Forward LMS rows:
(.4122214708,.5363325363,.0514459929),(.2119034982,.6806995451,.1073969566),
(.0883024619,.2817188376,.6299787005), cube roots, then
(.2104542553,.7936177850,-.0040720468),(1.9779984951,-2.4285922050,.4505937099),
(.0259040371,.7827717662,-.8086757660). Inverse uses
l'=L+.3963377774a+.2158037573b, m'=L-.1055613458a-.0638541728b,
s'=L-.0894841775a-1.2914855480b; cube; then
(4.0767416621,-3.3077115913,.2309699292),(-1.2684380046,2.6097574011,-.3413193965),
(-.0041960863,-.7034186147,1.7076147010). Work=stops+count. Fixtures: exact black/white endpoint
copies; red-to-blue count3 has an approximate specified interior tolerance per channel 1e-9.
Studies: terrain ramp; ribbon palette. Primary: https://bottosson.github.io/posts/oklab/
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export oklabRamp(input) from packages/javascript/src/oklab-ramp.js. Other targets deferred.
behavior.arithmetic_order: Matrix row sums are (a*x+b*y)+c*z with separate checked operations. Interpolation is start+t*(end-start) per L,a,b component. Cube by (x*x)*x, and use Math.cbrt for forward LMS. Encoded output k=0 and k=count-1 copies endpoints exactly; internal stop positions are evaluated through the declared matrices. Clamp reconstructed linear channels to [0,1] before the stated encoding formula; this is component clipping, not perceptual gamut mapping.
